The name Navil is a reminder of the rich history of Islamic navigation and seafaring tradition, which played a significant role in the spread of Islam to various parts of the world.

Just as a sea voyage involves facing various challenges and hardships, the spiritual journey involves overcoming the trials and tribulations of life. Navil can be seen as a reminder to always stay focused on the spiritual journey and to persist through the challenges, just as a sailor would continue on a dangerous voyage to reach his destination.
